svg.aria-label: Chapter I, The Gate. Night at the mouth of the Catacombs: a torch-lit stone gatehouse dug into a dark barrow, its arched doorway barred by an iron portcullis with green light and glowing eyes behind it. The Gatekeeper, a stone gargoyle with glowing yellow eyes, crouches on the lintel. Above the door three gems are carved in a row: RED, GREEN, GOLD, labelled underneath "red · green · prove". On the left the ape paladin, Brakka the dwarf and the three clockwork constructs look up at the gargoyle; graves and a dead tree on the right.

svg.text: I AM THE FIRST WORD OF EVERY HONEST FIX.
I COME BEFORE GREEN. NAME ME.
